exceptions.reason: Edge Functions hold the service-role key and deploy from CI success without a GitHub environment, so no reviewer or scoped secret stands between a green main and production. Fixing it adds an approval to every function deploy; that is a decision for the maintainer, recorded rather than made by a policy PR.

actions/deploy-pages needs id-token on the deploy job. It is granted workflow-wide today; narrowing it to the job is a one-line move that has to be proven against a real Pages deploy, which this change cannot do.
